name: Hades
label: Idle
description: Heavy menacing combat idle breathing loop in place, strict side-scroller profile facing RIGHT. Deep slow rise and fall of the broad chest and spiked pauldrons, subtle clinking sway of the hanging iron chains and ragged loincloth, slight shift of the hand gripping the curved sickle, heavy boots planted firmly on the exact same floor baseline. Return cleanly to the initial standing pose. Preserve crisp dark hermetic pixel art, same scale and palette. Static camera, transparent background.
